__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl. as the plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’them’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῶν ’on them’) · also gen. pl. dependent on a noun, ’of them’ (ἄνυσις … αὐτῶν ’accomplishment of them’) · also intensive, gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’of the men themselves’ (ποδῶν αὐτῶν τε καὶ ἵππων ’of the very men’s feet and of the horses’) · also gen. pl. standing alone for the men, as against their horses: ’of the men themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἠδ’ ἵππων ’of the men and of the horses’) · also intensive, gen. pl. with a pronoun: τῶν … αὐτῶν ’of those very men’

__broaden__.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’
